name: Split Lantern
sharedDoctrine: Act promptly. Kite scouts West Transit to Relay Nexus and reports Wren’s safe route. Wren reaches Auxiliary Reactor and repairs. Kite calls a sync turn from Alpha; Wren activates Beta then. Kite gets the recorder; both extract.

kite.roleOrder: Go west-hall, junction. WAIT and message safe route IDs. Go console-alpha. After power message “sync next turn”; next turn activate. Get recorder; extract.

wren.roleOrder: WAIT for route message; follow IDs to auxiliary-power. Repair until online. Go junction, console-beta. On sync message wait for named turn, activate; extract.

hypothesis: Kite will identify the safe route and hold Alpha while Wren completes power. They will agree on a sync turn, Kite will courier the recorder, and both will return together.
